Os 44 % são de 2000–2013 e de todas as anafilaxias por artrópode, não dos 42 do ABS: nunca '< HALF' ao lado da barra dos 42 (DF-04).

texto_aprovado: In the venom records, the top of the list isn't a snake. It's bees and wasps. Those deaths usually come from anaphylaxis, a severe allergic reaction, and in one study of those deaths, fewer than half of the people reached medical care before they died.
